description: Main window, all builds. No core:* permission on purpose: the front only calls the app's own commands through invoke, and never uses the event, window, webview, path, app, menu, tray or resources JS APIs (the tray is built from Rust, which is not subject to the ACL). The opener plugin is limited to opener:allow-open-url scoped to http(s) URLs (never opener:default, which also allows mailto:, tel: and reveal-item-in-dir), with deny entries for URLs containing a quote or a space; the front only calls openUrl, through core/UrlOpener, and the plugin's own click listener on external links is disabled in lib.rs (open_js_links_on_click(false)). The weather commands only reach the two Open-Meteo hosts fixed in src/net (Endpoint enum); there is no http:* permission and the CSP connect-src stays local. Backup and config-transfer commands open native dialogs from Rust only; no dialog:*, fs:* or process:* permission. The time commands (time_validate, time_expand) are pure and stateless (no disk, network or state). The schedule commands (reminder_*, session_*) read and write only the reminders, reminder_deliveries and time_sessions tables, with bounded, validated inputs. The habit commands (habit_*) read and write only the habits and habit_checks tables and the reminders owned by a habit, with bounded, validated inputs; notifications are shown from Rust only (no notification:* permission). The data commands (setting_*, dashboard_*, widget_*, note_*, shortcut_*, todo_*) read and write only the settings, dashboards, widget_instances, notes, shortcuts, todo_lists and todos tables, with bound parameters and bounded, validated inputs. There is no sql:* permission: tauri-plugin-sql only runs the migrations from Rust (preload). Remove core:default, add a specific core:<module>:allow-<command> only when the front starts using one.
